note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Ballymoney rural district, one member each. Nominations were lodged on 7 May 1924: no nominations were received for Ballycraigagh, Bushmills, Dunluce, Kirkmoyle, Portrush rural and Vow, and two divisions (Corkey and Enagh) had two candidates each (Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1924). No poll result for those two divisions was traced, so only the fourteen single nominations are recorded; the six vacant divisions were filled later by co-option. Sole nomination; retiring member. Returned unopposed.
